summary: Agent roster refreshes classify at most 4096 claim rows per delta and assemble large rosters through resumable subject-keyset pages. Each background roster snapshot has a two-second cooperative wall deadline. Completed pages and comparison coverage survive cancelled attempts and target extensions; timed-out delta pages independently shrink. Ordinary work progress and renewals invalidate only their agent dependencies. A bounded final snapshot classifies the remaining tail and folds its affected cards atomically, allowing publication while activity continues.

replay.detail: No persisted projection replay. Overflow rebuilds only the in-memory roster cache from the complete current cut.

rules.detail: No membership, invalidation, retention or checkpoint policy change.

compatibility.detail: No client or wire change. A refresh that exhausts its deadline retains the previous publication and resumes its saved membership/delta cursors on the next attempt. Delta and tail classification borrow the current assembled cards as their sole dependency source, including when the initial reconciliation target has no changes.
